TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.label: Shedscale
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.description: A reptile-themed tattoo that regrows its wearer's missing body parts automatically, over time — a hand, an eye, a lost kidney, whatever's genuinely gone. Requires no player action; an installed prosthetic or bionic blocks a part's regrowth entirely until it's surgically removed. What grows back at first is weaker than the original, cartilage rather than bone, until the tattoo has proven itself enough to stop happening.
TattooMagic.TattooMagicDef.modifierSummary: Tier 1: regrows missing external limbs/extremities in 7 days each, at reduced efficiency; every eligible missing part regrows at once. Raised hunger and mild pain per part currently regrowing, plus a mood penalty while any regrowth is active. Reaches Tier 2 after 30 days worn or 3 parts regrown, whichever comes first. Tier 2: regrowth also covers internal organs, takes only 4 days per part, and comes back at full efficiency — retroactively clearing the penalty from any part already regrown at Tier 1. No cap on how many colonists may wear this tattoo.
